policy: Exact CPU Actor.forward, two native features only; no noise, pulses, extra info, scripts or hints

config_provenance.digest_note: Hash covers redacted parsed config, not secret-bearing YAML bytes

checkpoint.training_provenance: embedded fields checked; omitted fields unknown

network_source.trust_note: Exact trusted networks.py executes Python; not a sandbox

checkpoint.q_interpretation: TD3 Q heads were trained on noisy replay actions with a clipped noisy, smoothed target policy and bootstrap across TimeLimit. Observed deterministic Actor rewards stop at the native episode boundary. Policy and horizon differ; Q versus Monte Carlo points are not exact greedy finite-horizon calibration or proof of overestimation. Legacy checkpoint training semantics are unknown.

counter_units.environment_steps: Actual native transitions; top-level checkpoint step is a legacy alias
counter_units.vector_steps: Vector step calls, not native transitions
counter_units.optimizer_updates: Critic optimizer updates; legacy agent.global_step has these units
counter_units.actor_updates: Actual delayed actor updates if logged; never inferred from a ratio
counter_units.global_step: Raw legacy agent critic-update counter, NOT checkpoint step or env transitions
counter_units.step: Raw top-level checkpoint environment-transition count, NOT agent.global_step

native_environment.goal_definition: native terminated AND engine position >= 0.45 AND velocity >= 0; no caller cap; never inferred from return
native_environment.reward_definition: 100 on native goal minus 0.1 * native action^2
native_environment.benchmark_note: Native mean-return benchmark 90, distinct from each episode's physical goal predicate
